top_signals.title: Eastspring's Wong on Opportunities Amid AI Volatility
top_signals.summary: Ken Wong, Asian Equity Portfolio Specialist at Eastspring Investments, breaks down where investors can find opportunities amid an on-and-off selloff in AI-related equities, pointing to electronic component companies as a strong contender. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Japanese population falls below 120 million for first time in decades
top_signals.summary: The population of Japanese residents has been declining for 17 consecutive years since peaking in 2009.
